name: Synvane Studio
positioning: Synvane Studio is the experimental production studio that uses AI to explore hundreds of directions and human craft to finish the few worth shipping, for brands that refuse the template.
audience: Brand, marketing and creative leads at culture-facing companies (music, fashion, food and drink, publishing, events) who want distinctive campaign visuals at speed without losing authorship.
strategy: Own the space between generic AI output and slow traditional agencies by making the process itself the product: a visible 'diverge, then decide' method, open studio Labs and a published set of AI principles. Content leads with the work and the craft behind it, turning transparency about tools into a trust advantage.

contrastPairs.use: body text and headlines on Bone
body text on dark sections and dark social canvases
accent labels, CTA text on Carbon buttons
text on lime stickers, bands and buttons
body text on the pink principles section and pink tags
step numbers and eyebrows on Carbon
body text on Render Blue sections and Facebook canvas

designSystem.spacing: 8px base; section padding clamp(4rem, 9vw, 8rem); 12-column grid with deliberate offsets and negative margins so blocks overlap
designSystem.radius: Two extremes only: 0 for frames, cards and fields; full pill (999px) for buttons, tags and stickers
designSystem.borders: Hard 2-3px Carbon outlines on every frame; a second Render Blue outline offset and counter-rotated behind key frames
designSystem.imagery: Iridescent gradient meshes (blurred pink, blue and lime blobs) clipped into collage frames, overlaid with generative wave lines and paper grain
designSystem.shapes: Tilted rectangular collage frames (plus or minus 2 to 7 degrees), wobbling concentric rings, pinwheel vane blades, diagonal stripes
designSystem.buttons: Pill buttons in Carbon with Acid Lime uppercase Unbounded text; hover lifts up-left with a hard pink offset shadow
designSystem.cards: White or Bone cards with 3px Carbon borders, slight rotation, a pill tag breaking the top edge, hover/focus reveals a Carbon 'how it was made' layer
designSystem.motifs: Chromatic-aberration type (pink and blue offsets behind Carbon), horizontally stretched display words, rotated marquee bands, the four-blade vane mark

artDirection: Every creative is a collage: at least one tilted frame holding an iridescent mesh, one generative line layer, and one piece of distorted type with pink and blue offsets. Alternate canvases between Bone, Carbon and Render Blue so the feed reads as a rhythm, and use Acid Lime only for stickers, bands and the single most important action. Headlines are short, uppercase Unbounded statements set big enough to break into neighbouring frames; supporting copy in Sora stays calm and plain-spoken. Always credit the human craft alongside the machine, and never imitate a named artist's style.
